main.description: The files of a pull's diff that `paths` names, rows and all, as dev.knotless.getThread shows them, for a page that listed them with its `filesOnly`. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

errors.description: No such repository or pull, or the pull's branch is gone.
errors.name: NotFound

files.description: Those of the files named that the pull changes, as an editor's file tree lists them, in each directory its directories before its files, each by name.

paths.description: The files, by their paths after the change, or before it for one deleted; a renamed file is found as such only when both its paths are named.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

description: Some files of a pull's diff.
